paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: Comparison between PyramidInfer and full cache baseline with different batch sizes on the LLaMA 2-7B model with input length of 512+256.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the throughput for two different methods, PyramidInfer and Full Cache, across varying batch sizes. The x-axis is labeled "Batch Size" and employs a linear scale with an estimated range of 0 to 70, displaying numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 20. The y-axis is labeled "Throughput (token/s)" and uses a linear scale with a value range from 0 to slightly above 2500, featuring numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 500. The data for "PyramidInfer" is represented by a solid pink line with circular markers. This line demonstrates a continuous upward trend across the x-axis, starting at a throughput of approximately 100 token/s at a batch size of 1 and climbing steadily to end at roughly 2650 token/s at a batch size of 64. The "Full Cache" data is depicted by a solid turquoise line with circular markers. This line begins at approximately 100 token/s at a batch size of 1, increases to reach a peak of roughly 1250 token/s at a batch size of 32, and subsequently declines, ending at approximately 950 token/s at a batch size of 64.
